title: NPSLE coding transportability: analysis code for transportability and structural limits of administrative neuropsychiatric phenotyping in a three-database ICU evaluation
description:
Analysis code (SQL database screen + Python pipeline) for the study 'Transportability and structural limits of administrative neuropsychiatric phenotyping in critically ill patients with systemic lupus erythematosus: a three-database evaluation'.

The pipeline reconstructs aligned cohorts of critically ill patients with systemic lupus erythematosus from three PhysioNet-credentialed ICU databases (MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, NWICU), assigns an investigator-proposed diagnostic-confidence tier to every recorded neuropsychiatric code, and computes: (i) prevalence and tier composition per database; (ii) the sepsis/neuropsychiatric co-occurrence association with a cross-database random-effects pooled estimate; (iii) a three-layer quantitative bias framework - attenuation under imperfect positive predictive value, the definitional-overlap magnitude that would null the association, and E-values - together with a test distinguishing effect homogeneity from measurement equivalence; and (iv) internal versus external discrimination and calibration of routine-data prediction models.

The repository contains code only. No patient-level data are published (PhysioNet Data Use Agreement).
